description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Fire with Stacking], [Awoken Fire], [Damage Cap +10000], [Fire Ability Instant Cast (15s)] and [Slash & Soar] to the user

description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Awoken Fire
description.text: Fire abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Fire abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Fire Ability Instant Cast (15s)
description.text: Instant cast speed for Fire abilities

description.name: Slash & Soar
description.text: Grants [Fire Ability +30% Boost 1] to the user after using two Fire abilities
